ResStock 2025 Release 1 Measure Documentation: Attic Floor Insulation Accessing Results This documentation covers the “attic floor insulation for unfinished attics” measure upgrade methodology and briefly discusses key results. All results can be accessed on the ResStock Open Energy Data Initiative “End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. Building Stock” data lake and on the data viewer at resstock.nlr.gov. Measure Summary Measure Attic Floor Insulation Title Measure This measure upgrades attic floor insulation in unfinished attics where the existing R- Definition value falls at least R-10 value below the maximum level recommended by the IECC for each unit’s climate zone. The post-retrofit R-value is set to reflect the maximum value recommended by code, while still aligning with outcomes observed in empirical studies. For example, while the IECC recommends an R-value range of R-49 to R-60 for climate zone 2, dwelling units in this zone are upgraded to R-60 to represent the upper bound of achievable performance. This approach ensures that the modeled retrofit captures both the energy savings potential of code-compliant upgrades and the levels typically achieved in field implementations. Applica- This measure applied to all units that meet the following conditions: bility • The unit has an existing unconditioned and accessible attic • The existing attic floor insulation R-value is below the IECC-recommended level for the corresponding climate zone. With these applicability constraints, the measure upgrade applies to 42.9% of existing dwelling units. Not • This measure package will not apply to: Dwellings without existing attics Applicable • Dwellings with floor insulation R-value at the code requirement. These constraints exclude 57.1% of dwelling units from receiving this measure upgrade.
